behavioral.q_en: Tell me about a time you solved a difficult problem.
behavioral.q_es: Cuéntame sobre una vez que resolviste un problema difícil.
behavioral.a_en: Situation: When I joined the Brazil/Caribbean AP team at Brinks, I inherited a backlog with 60% unresolved billing discrepancies across 15+ vendors. Task: I needed to clear this backlog while maintaining current operations. Action: I categorized discrepancies by type and amount, prioritized high-value items, applied systematic three-way matching (invoice, PO, receiving report), and built SQL queries to cross-reference payment records automatically. Result: Resolved the entire backlog within 18 months. The new process kept discrepancies near zero going forward.
behavioral.a_es: Situación: Al unirme al equipo AP de Brasil/Caribe en Brinks, heredé 60% de discrepancias de facturación sin resolver con 15+ proveedores. Tarea: Limpiar el backlog sin descuidar operaciones actuales. Acción: Categoricé por tipo y monto, prioricé alto valor, apliqué three-way matching sistemático y construí queries SQL para cruzar registros automáticamente. Resultado: Resolví todo en 18 meses. El nuevo proceso mantuvo discrepancias cerca de cero.

behavioral.q_en: Describe a process improvement you implemented.
behavioral.q_es: Describe una mejora de proceso que implementaste.
behavioral.a_en: Situation: Payment tracking at Brinks was entirely manual — spreadsheets updated by hand, prone to errors and delays. Task: Find a way to automate tracking without new software purchases. Action: I built SQL queries that cross-referenced invoices against payment confirmations in our database, flagging discrepancies in real-time. Then I created a Power BI dashboard showing AP aging, throughput, and exceptions — giving leadership instant visibility. Result: Reduced tracking time by 15%, eliminated manual errors that were causing delayed payments, and the dashboard became a standard reporting tool for the department.
behavioral.a_es: Situación: El seguimiento de pagos en Brinks era totalmente manual — hojas de cálculo actualizadas a mano, propensas a errores. Tarea: Automatizar sin comprar software nuevo. Acción: Construí queries SQL que cruzaban facturas contra confirmaciones de pago, señalando discrepancias en tiempo real. Luego creé un dashboard Power BI de aging, throughput y excepciones. Resultado: Redujo tiempo 15%, eliminó errores manuales, y el dashboard se convirtió en herramienta estándar del departamento.

behavioral.q_en: How do you handle working under pressure or tight deadlines?
behavioral.q_es: ¿Cómo manejas trabajar bajo presión o plazos ajustados?
behavioral.a_en: Situation: At Brinks, monthly close had strict 3-day deadlines for AP reconciliation across two regions with different currencies and tax regulations. Task: Ensure zero delays while managing high volume. Action: I developed a prioritization system — critical items (high-value invoices, expiring discounts) first, then systematic queue processing. I pre-built SQL templates for recurring reconciliation checks. For unexpected spikes, I communicated proactively with the team. Currently at Teleperformance, I manage multiple queues simultaneously maintaining 95%+ accuracy under strict SLAs. Result: Never missed a single close deadline in 7 years at Brinks.
behavioral.a_es: Situación: En Brinks, el cierre mensual tenía deadline de 3 días para conciliación AP de dos regiones con diferentes monedas e impuestos. Tarea: Cero retrasos con alto volumen. Acción: Desarrollé sistema de priorización — críticos primero, luego procesamiento sistemático. Pre-construí templates SQL para chequeos recurrentes. Actualmente en Teleperformance mantengo 95%+ precisión bajo SLAs estrictos. Resultado: Nunca fallé un solo cierre en 7 años.

technical.q_en: Walk me through your AP experience.
technical.q_es: Cuéntame tu experiencia en Cuentas por Pagar.
technical.a_en: For 7 years at Brinks, I managed the complete AP cycle for Brazil and Caribbean in a shared services model. That means: invoice intake and validation, three-way matching against POs and receiving reports, proper GL coding, supplier reconciliation, payment execution coordinated with Treasury, aging report management, and monthly close. Multi-currency environment with different tax regulations per country, 15+ active vendors. I also built the KPI monitoring layer — SQL queries feeding Power BI dashboards for aging buckets, processing throughput, exception rates. This gave leadership real-time visibility they never had before.
technical.a_es: 7 años en Brinks: ciclo completo de CxP para Brasil y Caribe en shared services. Recepción y validación de facturas, three-way matching contra OC y recibos, codificación GL, conciliación de proveedores, ejecución de pagos con Tesorería, gestión de aging reports, cierre mensual. Multi-moneda con diferentes regulaciones tributarias, 15+ proveedores activos. Además construí la capa de monitoreo de KPIs — queries SQL alimentando dashboards Power BI.

technical.q_en: Tell me about a project where you used SQL for data analysis.
technical.q_es: Cuéntame un proyecto donde usaste SQL para análisis de datos.
technical.a_en: Situation: Payment tracking at Brinks was manual and error-prone. Task: Build an automated system using existing tools. Action: I wrote complex SQL queries with JOINs across invoice, payment, and vendor tables — cross-referencing expected vs. actual payments, flagging discrepancies in real-time. I used window functions for running totals and aging calculations, CTEs for readable multi-step logic. Connected the output to Power BI for dashboard visualization. Result: 15% reduction in tracking time, zero manual errors, and leadership gained real-time KPI visibility for the first time.
technical.a_es: Situación: Seguimiento de pagos en Brinks era manual y propenso a errores. Tarea: Construir sistema automatizado con herramientas existentes. Acción: Escribí queries SQL complejos con JOINs entre tablas de facturas, pagos y proveedores — cruzando pagos esperados vs. reales, señalando discrepancias en tiempo real. Window functions para totales acumulados, CTEs para lógica multi-paso. Conecté a Power BI para dashboards. Resultado: 15% reducción en tiempo, cero errores manuales, visibilidad de KPIs en tiempo real.

technical.q_en: How do you ensure data accuracy in your work?
technical.q_es: ¿Cómo aseguras la precisión de los datos en tu trabajo?
technical.a_en: Three layers: prevention, detection, correction. Prevention: I build validation rules directly into SQL queries and Excel templates — data type checks, range validations, duplicate detection. Detection: automated reconciliation scripts that flag mismatches before they reach reports. At Brinks, I ran daily validation queries comparing our records against bank statements. Correction: when issues are found, I trace them to the source — was it a data entry error, a system sync issue, or a genuine discrepancy? Currently at Teleperformance, I maintain 95%+ accuracy processing high-volume data under SLAs, which reinforces this discipline.
technical.a_es: Tres capas: prevención, detección, corrección. Prevención: reglas de validación en queries SQL y plantillas Excel — verificación de tipos, rangos, duplicados. Detección: scripts de conciliación automática que señalan discrepancias antes de llegar a reportes. En Brinks ejecutaba validaciones diarias contra extractos bancarios. Corrección: rastreo hasta la fuente. Actualmente en Teleperformance, 95%+ precisión bajo SLAs refuerza esta disciplina.

technical.q_en: What experience do you have with Power BI or dashboards?
technical.q_es: ¿Qué experiencia tienes con Power BI o dashboards?
technical.a_en: At Brinks, I designed and built Power BI dashboards from scratch for the AP department. The main dashboard tracked: aging buckets (current, 30, 60, 90+ days), payment throughput by week and month, exception rates by vendor and region, discount capture rate, and processing cost per invoice. I connected it directly to our SQL database using DirectQuery for near-real-time data. I also used Power Query for data transformation — cleaning messy exports from different regional systems into a unified model. The dashboard became the primary tool for leadership's monthly AP review meetings.
technical.a_es: En Brinks diseñé y construí dashboards Power BI desde cero para el departamento AP. El dashboard principal rastreaba: aging buckets (corriente, 30, 60, 90+ días), throughput de pagos semanal/mensual, tasa de excepciones por proveedor y región, captura de descuentos, costo por factura. Conecté directamente a nuestra base SQL con DirectQuery. Usé Power Query para transformar datos — limpiando exports de diferentes sistemas regionales. Se convirtió en la herramienta principal para las reuniones mensuales de AP.

technical.q_en: How do you handle vendor disputes or billing discrepancies?
technical.q_es: ¿Cómo manejas disputas con proveedores o discrepancias de facturación?
technical.a_en: Systematic approach. First, verify the data — three-way matching between invoice, purchase order, and receiving report. 80% of disputes resolve at this stage because the discrepancy is usually a missing document or a pricing error. For genuine disputes: I compile documented evidence (emails, PO terms, delivery confirmations), present it clearly to the vendor, and negotiate professionally. At Brinks, I used this approach to resolve 60% of historical outstanding items. Key principle: always approach vendors as partners, not adversaries — you need them for future business.
technical.a_es: Enfoque sistemático. Primero, verificar datos — three-way matching entre factura, orden de compra y reporte de recepción. 80% se resuelve ahí porque la discrepancia suele ser un documento faltante o error de precio. Para disputas genuinas: compilo evidencia documentada (emails, términos de OC, confirmaciones de entrega), la presento claramente y negocio profesionalmente. En Brinks resolví 60% de discrepancias históricas con este enfoque. Principio clave: tratar proveedores como socios, no adversarios.

technical.q_en: What ERP systems have you worked with?
technical.a_en: At Brinks, I worked with the company's financial ERP for invoice processing, payment execution, vendor management, and reporting across Brazil and Caribbean operations. I extracted data from the ERP via SQL for my Power BI dashboards — essentially building an analytics layer on top of the transactional system. I'm comfortable learning new ERPs quickly — my Systems Engineering background gives me a strong foundation for understanding any software architecture. I've also worked with Excel-based and custom internal tools at Express Microfinanzas for credit risk analysis.
technical.a_es: En Brinks trabajé con el ERP financiero para procesamiento de facturas, ejecución de pagos, gestión de proveedores y reporting para Brasil y Caribe. Extraía datos del ERP vía SQL para mis dashboards Power BI — construyendo una capa analítica sobre el sistema transaccional. Mi formación en Ingeniería de Sistemas me permite aprender ERPs nuevos rápidamente. También trabajé con herramientas Excel y sistemas internos en Express Microfinanzas.
